bio: The Shangri-La, a superb Parisian palace hotel, takes us on a voyage to the far reaches of Asia, to an opulent imaginary paradise. This restaurant transports diners with its opulent version of Chinese haute cuisine. Traditional Cantonese cuisine may play the leading role, but the chef also delves into the culinary repertory of Sichuan: Peking duck served in two courses; fresh blue lobster gong bao with glazed aubergines and macadamia nuts; ice plant salad with sesame sauce; red rice rolls with prawns; and a dim sum menu at lunchtime....
